SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001142
DOCKET NO. F01248825
PLAINTIFF – BANK OF AMERICA, N.A.
DEFENDANTS- DONALD LEONARD, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday THE 5th DAY OF August 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Borough of JAMESBURG, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 338 QUALIFIER C-131 BLOCK 75.01
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
14 DOGWOOD COURT JAMESBURG, NJ 08831
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes: MUNICIPALITY: Jamesburg Borough ZIP: 08831
COUNTY: MIDDLESEX STATE OF N. J.
STREET & STREET NO: 14 Dogwood Court.
TAX BLOCK AND LOT: BLOCK: 75.01 LOT: 338 Qualifier C-131
DIMENSIONS OF LOT: Unit 131 in Building 21, Section 3
NEAREST CROSS STREET: Beaver Brook Run Condominium, a condominium.
SUPERIOR INTERESTS (if any): Any and all easements, covenants, restrictions and reservations of record; Any set of facts which an accurate survey and inspection would disclose; All unpaid municipal taxes, assessments and liens; Any unpaid assessment and any outstanding tax sale certificate; Rights of any party in possession/rights protected by the NJ Anti-Eviction Act; All Local, County, State and Federal ordinances and regulations; Any condominium association lien granted priority by N.J.S.A 46:8B-21b; Any outstanding Condominium, PUD or Homeowner Association dues or fees; Rights of the United States of America, if any; The property is sold in its "AS IS" condition; Purchaser shall be responsible for Sheriffs costs, commission, deed recording fees and realty transfer fees.
Beaver Brook Run Condominium Association, Inc. holds a condominium lien and may be entitled to a 6 month priority if applicable as of 05/17/2024.
Trystone Capital Assets, LLC holds a tax sale certificate in the amount of $181.97 as of 12/31/2024.
Jamesburg Boro holds a claim in the amount of $110.00 and $220.00 plus penalty for sewer as of 03/18/2026.
Plaintiffs upset bid is $324,637.95 in accordance with the requirements of Section 12 of P.L. 1995, c. 244 (C.2A:50-64) as amended.
The property is reported to be non-owner occupied.
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Middlesex County in Mortgage Book 10849 Page 728.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice through publication.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $299,327.76 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: May 19, 2026
POWERS KIRN LLC
308 HARPER DRIVE SUITE 210
MOORESTOWN, NJ 08057
(856) 327-5852
